q: Five persons A, B, C, D and E sit around a circular table facing the center. A sits to the left of B. C sits to the right of B. D sits to the right of C. Who sits between A and C?
exp: Taking B as reference and moving clockwise as right for center-facing persons, C is to B's right and A to B's left. Hence B sits between A and C.

q: Six persons P, Q, R, S, T and U sit around a circular table facing the center. P sits second to the left of Q. R sits immediately right of P. S sits opposite Q. Who sits immediately left of S?
exp: Fix Q at the top. P is second to Q's left, R is immediately right of P, and S is opposite Q. The remaining positions place T immediately left of S.

q: Seven persons A, B, C, D, E, F and G sit around a circular table facing the center. A sits between B and G. C sits second to the right of B. D sits immediately right of C. E sits immediately left of G. Who sits between D and E?
exp: A is between B and G, C is second right of B, D right of C, and E left of G. The remaining person F occupies the position between D and E.

q: Eight persons P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W sit around a circular table facing the center. P sits opposite Q. R sits immediately left of P. S sits immediately right of Q. T sits second to the left of R. Who sits opposite T?
exp: Place P and Q opposite. With R left of P and T second left of R, T is fixed at the position opposite W. Hence W sits opposite T.

q: Six persons A, B, C, D, E and F sit around a circular table facing the center. A is immediately left of B. C is immediately left of D. E sits between B and C. Who sits immediately right of D?
exp: The order can be A-B-E-C-D-F around the circle. Therefore F sits immediately right of D.

q: Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H sit around a circular table facing the center. A is opposite E. B is immediately left of A. C is immediately right of E. D is second to the right of B. Who is opposite B?
exp: Fix A opposite E. B is left of A and D is second right of B. The position opposite B is occupied by F.

q: Five persons P, Q, R, S and T sit around a circular table facing the center. P sits immediately right of Q. R sits immediately right of P. S sits immediately left of Q. Who sits between S and R?
exp: The circular order is Q-P-R-T-S. Therefore T sits between S and R.

q: Seven persons L, M, N, O, P, Q and R sit around a circular table facing the center. L sits immediately left of M. N sits immediately right of O. P sits second to the right of M. Q sits between P and R. Who sits immediately left of L?
exp: Fix M and place L immediately left of M. With the remaining conditions, R occupies the position immediately left of L.

q: Six persons A, B, C, D, E and F sit around a circular table facing the center. A sits opposite D. B sits immediately right of A. C sits immediately left of D. Who sits opposite B?
exp: A and D are opposite. B is right of A and C is left of D. Thus B and E occupy opposite positions, so E is opposite B.

q: Eight persons P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W sit around a circular table facing the center. P is between Q and W. R is opposite P. S is immediately right of R. T is immediately left of W. Who sits immediately right of Q?
exp: Since P is between Q and W, Q is immediately left of P. Therefore P is immediately right of Q.

q: Seven persons A, B, C, D, E, F and G sit around a circular table facing the center. A sits second to the right of B. C sits immediately left of A. D sits opposite G. E sits between B and F. Who sits immediately right of C?
exp: C is immediately left of A, so A is immediately right of C.

q: Six persons P, Q, R, S, T and U sit around a circular table facing the center. P sits immediately left of Q. R sits second to the right of Q. S sits opposite P. T sits immediately left of S. Who sits immediately right of T?
exp: T is immediately left of S, so S is immediately right of T.

q: Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H sit around a circular table facing the center. A sits opposite E. B is second to the left of A. C is immediately right of B. D is immediately left of E. F sits between E and G. Who sits opposite C?
exp: After fixing A opposite E, the conditions place C at the position opposite H. Hence H is opposite C.

q: Five persons A, B, C, D and E sit around a circular table facing the center. A sits immediately left of B. C sits immediately left of D. E sits between B and C. Who sits immediately right of E?
exp: The order is A-B-E-C-D. Therefore C sits immediately right of E.

q: Seven persons P, Q, R, S, T, U and V sit around a circular table facing the center. P sits opposite S. Q sits immediately left of P. R sits second to the right of Q. T sits immediately left of S. U sits between R and V. Who sits immediately right of T?
exp: T sits immediately left of S, so S sits immediately right of T.

q: Eight persons K, L, M, N, O, P, Q and R sit around a circular table facing the center. K is immediately right of L. M is opposite K. N is immediately left of M. O is second to the right of L. P sits between Q and R. Who is immediately right of N?
exp: N is immediately left of M, so M is immediately right of N.

q: Six persons A, B, C, D, E and F sit around a circular table facing the center. A sits between B and F. C sits opposite F. D sits immediately left of C. Who sits immediately right of B?
exp: Since A sits between B and F, A is immediately right of B.

q: Eight persons P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W sit around a circular table facing the center. P sits opposite T. Q sits immediately left of P. R sits immediately right of T. S sits second to the left of R. U sits between V and W. Who sits opposite Q?
exp: With P opposite T and Q left of P, the position opposite Q is V.

q: Seven persons A, B, C, D, E, F and G sit around a circular table facing the center. A sits immediately right of B. C sits immediately right of D. E sits between B and D. F sits opposite A. Who sits immediately left of G?
exp: After fixing the arrangement, F is immediately left of G.

q: Six persons P, Q, R, S, T and U sit around a circular table. P, Q and R face the center, while S, T and U face outward. P sits immediately left of Q. S sits immediately right of T. R sits opposite T. Who sits opposite Q?
exp: Using the facing directions, the fixed relations place U opposite Q.

q: Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H sit around a circular table. A, B, C and D face the center while E, F, G and H face outward. A is opposite E. B is immediately right of A. F is immediately right of E. Which person is opposite B?
exp: A is opposite E. Since B is immediately right of A and F is immediately right of E, the position opposite B is occupied by H.

q: Six persons M, N, O, P, Q and R sit around a circular table. M, N and O face the center, while P, Q and R face outward. M is opposite P. N is immediately left of M. Q is immediately left of P. Who is opposite N?
exp: N is immediately left of M. Because P is opposite M and Q is immediately left of P, the position opposite N is R.

q: Eight persons P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W sit around a circular table. P, Q, R and S face the center, while T, U, V and W face outward. P is opposite T. Q is immediately right of P. U is immediately right of T. Which person is opposite Q?
exp: Q is immediately right of P. U is immediately right of T, so the position opposite Q is W.

q: Seven persons A, B, C, D, E, F and G sit around a circular table facing the center. A is older than B, B is older than C, D is older than A, E is younger than C, and F is older than D. Who is the oldest?
exp: The age order is F > D > A > B > C > E, with G unspecified. Among the options, F is definitely older than all specified persons.

q: Six persons P, Q, R, S, T and U sit around a circular table facing the center. P is taller than Q, Q is taller than R, S is taller than P, T is shorter than R, and U is taller than S. Who is the shortest?
exp: The height order is U > S > P > Q > R > T. Therefore T is shortest.

q: Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H sit around a circular table facing the center. A sits opposite E. B is immediately left of A. C is immediately right of E. D is taller than B, F is taller than D, and G is shorter than H. Who among D and F is taller?
exp: It is directly stated that F is taller than D. Therefore F is taller.

q: Seven persons P, Q, R, S, T, U and V sit around a circular table facing the center. P is immediately left of Q. R is immediately right of Q. S sits opposite P. T is second to the left of S. U sits between T and V. Who is immediately right of P?
exp: P is immediately left of Q, so Q is immediately right of P.

q: Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H sit around a circular table facing the center. A is opposite E. B is immediately right of A. C is immediately right of B. D is immediately right of E. Who sits opposite C?
exp: Starting with A opposite E, B and C occupy successive positions to A's right. The position opposite C is G.

q: Six persons P, Q, R, S, T and U sit around a circular table facing the center. P sits between Q and U. R sits opposite P. S sits immediately left of R. Who sits immediately right of R?
exp: S is immediately left of R, so the position immediately right of R is occupied by T.

q: Eight persons K, L, M, N, O, P, Q and R sit around a circular table facing the center. K sits opposite O. L sits immediately left of K. M sits immediately left of N. P sits immediately right of O. Q sits between N and R. Who sits immediately right of L?
exp: L sits immediately left of K, so K sits immediately right of L.

q: Seven persons A, B, C, D, E, F and G sit around a circular table facing the center. A sits second to the right of B. C sits opposite B. D sits immediately left of C. E sits immediately right of F. Who sits immediately right of D?
exp: D sits immediately left of C, so C sits immediately right of D.

q: Eight persons P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W sit around a circular table facing the center. P is immediately left of Q. R is immediately left of S. T is opposite Q. U is immediately right of T. V sits between W and P. Who sits opposite R?
exp: After fixing Q opposite T and the adjacent pairs, the position opposite R is occupied by U.

q: Six persons A, B, C, D, E and F sit around a circular table facing the center. A sits opposite D. B sits immediately left of A. C sits immediately left of D. Which two persons are adjacent to A?
exp: B is immediately left of A. Since D is opposite A, the other adjacent position to A is F. Therefore B and F are adjacent to A.

q: Seven persons P, Q, R, S, T, U and V sit around a circular table facing the center. P sits immediately right of Q. R sits immediately right of S. T sits opposite Q. U sits immediately left of V. Which pair must be adjacent?
exp: P is explicitly stated to sit immediately right of Q, so P and Q must be adjacent.

q: Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H sit around a circular table facing the center. A is opposite E. B is immediately right of A. C is immediately left of E. D is immediately right of C. F is immediately right of E. Who is opposite B?
exp: With A opposite E, B right of A and C left of E, the position opposite B is G.

q: Five persons P, Q, R, S and T sit around a circular table facing the center. P is immediately right of Q. R is immediately right of P. S is immediately right of R. Which person is immediately left of Q?
exp: The order is Q-P-R-S-T around the circle. Therefore T is immediately left of Q.

q: Six persons A, B, C, D, E and F sit around a circular table facing the center. A sits immediately left of B. C sits opposite A. D sits immediately right of C. E sits between B and F. Who sits opposite B?
exp: With A opposite C and D right of C, the remaining arrangement places F opposite B.

q: Eight persons P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W sit around a circular table facing the center. P sits between Q and W. R sits opposite P. S sits immediately left of R. T sits immediately right of W. U sits between V and S. Who is immediately right of Q?
exp: P sits between Q and W, so P is immediately right of Q.
